name: Bechtel
legalName: Bechtel Group, Inc. (principal operating company Bechtel Corporation)
founded: 1898 (Warren A. Bechtel; fifth generation of family leadership today)
employees: ~30,000-50,000 (third-party counts conflict: Forbes ~50k, GlobalData 43k, Revelio ~30k; careers site says 50,000)
summary: BOTTOM LINE UP FRONT: Bechtel is the West's megaproject house — ENR's #2 US contractor ($19.5B ENR-counted 2025 revenue; $20.6B company-stated 2024 with a $58.2B backlog that has more than doubled since 2020) — and it holds a near-monopoly on the 'electrons' side of the AI economy without being an incumbent hyperscale data-center GC. Its verifiable AI wedge is the October 2025 NVIDIA partnership to modularize the Omniverse DSX blueprint for gigawatt-scale AI factories (plus an offsite-manufacturing study for a confidential multi-country data-center customer); a circulating claim that Bechtel builds Microsoft's Fairwater campuses did NOT substantiate — Walsh Construction is the reported Mount Pleasant WI contractor. What Bechtel does own: the only EPC to bring 21st-century nuclear online in the US (Vogtle 3&4), construction start at TerraPower's Natrium (the first utility-scale advanced reactor with an NRC construction permit, April 2026), site takeover for Poland's first nuclear plant (3x AP1000, August 2026), three concurrent US LNG megaprojects (Rio Grande, Port Arthur, Louisiana LNG), the Micron Clay NY megafab, and Sentinel ICBM launch infrastructure (~450 silos). Watch items: a triple fatality at Port Arthur LNG (April 2025; Bechtel published a 7-factor internal report and overhauled safety practices), Sentinel's 81% cost breach concentrated in Bechtel's command-and-launch scope, and the Hanford legacy ($125M False Claims settlement, 2016 — vitrification finally began October 2025). Fifth-generation family control; no audited public financials; employee counts conflict by ~2x across trackers.
ecosystemRole: The megaproject EPC of the AI economy's foundations: not the GC building hyperscale shells today, but the firm building the nuclear plants, LNG trains, semiconductor megafabs, and — via the NVIDIA DSX partnership — the modularized gigawatt AI factories of the next phase, with the deepest first-of-a-kind execution bench in Western construction.

productsAndServices.name: AI Factories & Manufacturing/Technology
productsAndServices.category: Gigawatt-scale AI campus modularization, semiconductors, EV/battery
productsAndServices.description: The Manufacturing & Technology unit (President Catherine Hunt Ryan) holds the AI push: an October 2025 partnership to modularize NVIDIA's Omniverse DSX blueprint — turning NVIDIA's 1 GW reference architecture into deployable modules that compress time to 'first revenue token' — plus an offsite-manufacturing feasibility study for a confidential customer's data centers across several countries, a legacy Nautilus water-cooled data-center partnership, and the Micron Clay NY memory-fab complex ('largest private investment in New York state history,' 4,500+ peak construction jobs).
highlights: NVIDIA Omniverse DSX modularization announced at GTC Washington DC, 2025-10-28 — Bechtel as the constructor lens on NVIDIA's gigawatt AI-factory architecture
Micron Clay NY megafab EPC (release dated 2026-06-10; the relationship's start date traces earlier — flagged)

Verification note: no substantiated Bechtel role on Microsoft's Fairwater campuses (Walsh Construction is the reported Mount Pleasant WI builder) — Bechtel's AI-DC footprint is the NVIDIA partnership and confidential-study work, not incumbent hyperscale GC status
productsAndServices.positioning: Positioned for the phase where AI campuses stop looking like buildings and start looking like energy megaprojects — power, cooling, and site scale in gigawatts, delivered as factory-built modules
productsAndServices.soldThrough: EPC and partnership structures with technology owners (NVIDIA, Micron) and confidential hyperscale customers
productsAndServices.roadmap: DSX module deployment at partner sites; scaling offsite manufacturing for AI-DC delivery

productsAndServices.name: Nuclear (conventional, SMR & export)
productsAndServices.description: The signature franchise: company claims 70+ years in nuclear, 76 GW delivered, the largest US nuclear talent pool, and the distinction of being 'the only EPC contractor to bring 21st-century nuclear plants online in the US' — completing Vogtle Units 3 & 4 (AP1000s) after taking over from Westinghouse's bankruptcy. Now first-mover on advanced reactors (TerraPower Natrium EPC — construction started at Kemmerer Unit 1, April 2026, the first utility-scale advanced reactor with an NRC construction permit) and AP1000 export (site takeover August 2026 for Poland's first nuclear plant: 3 units, ~3 GW, for PEJ with Westinghouse).
highlights: Vogtle Unit 4 COD April 2024 — the site is the largest US clean-energy generator
Natrium: 345 MWe sodium fast reactor with molten-salt storage (boostable to 500 MWe), GE Hitachi design, PacifiCorp offtake, DOE ARDP backing
Poland Choczewo: 400+ on site (~one-third Polish hires), new Gdańsk office planned for ~200
productsAndServices.positioning: The execution incumbent in the reactor classes AI hyperscalers are underwriting for clean firm power — no US rival has completed a 21st-century large reactor
productsAndServices.soldThrough: EPC contracts with utilities, advanced-reactor developers, and sovereign programs
productsAndServices.roadmap: Natrium Unit 1 execution; Poland construction ramp; follow-on AP1000 export prospects

productsAndServices.name: LNG & Energy
productsAndServices.description: The dominant global LNG EPC (built most US liquefaction capacity — Sabine Pass and Corpus Christi for Cheniere) now running three concurrent US megaprojects: Rio Grande LNG (NextDecade — lump-sum turnkey, Phase 1 Trains 1-3 with Train 4 added Aug 2024; full build 5 trains / 27 mtpa; ~5,000 peak workers), Port Arthur LNG (Sempra — 2 trains, ~13.5 mtpa, ~5,000 peak workers), and Louisiana LNG (Woodside, ex-Driftwood — revised lump-sum turnkey signed Dec 2024, FID April 2025, 3 foundation trains / 16.5 mtpa, first LNG target 2029).
highlights: Three simultaneous LNG megatrains is a fleet no competitor matches — a near-monopoly among US megatrain builders
Louisiana LNG: Train 1 >22% complete with ~900 workers as of Sept 2025; project cost reported ~$17.9B (Woodside) to ~$27B (trade press)
Port Arthur carries the franchise's darkest recent mark: the April 2025 triple fatality (see risks)
productsAndServices.positioning: Lump-sum turnkey appetite at a scale public rivals (Fluor) have retreated from — margin opportunity and pricing risk in equal measure
productsAndServices.soldThrough: Lump-sum turnkey EPC with LNG developers
productsAndServices.roadmap: Trains delivering through 2029+; LNG demand underwritten partly by the same gas-hungry AI-power complex

productsAndServices.name: National Defense & Security
productsAndServices.description: Design and construction of launch infrastructure for the Sentinel (LGM-35A) ICBM program on Northrop Grumman's team — modernization tied to ~450 silos across eight states, with an operational target of 2036 and design life through 2075 — plus Ground-Based Midcourse Defense work and the Reagan Test Site at Kwajalein. Company reported ~$6.2B of defense work awarded in 2025 (unverified company figure).
highlights: March 2026: groundbreaking on the full-scale prototype Sentinel silo at Promontory, UT — the plan now requires 450 all-new silos after the May 2025 decision to scrap Minuteman silo reuse
Sentinel's 81% cost breach (~$140.9B) is concentrated in the command-and-launch segment — the infrastructure scope where Bechtel sits (program risk, but also enlarged scope)
productsAndServices.positioning: One of the few constructors with nuclear-weapons-complex and strategic-infrastructure credentials at national scale
productsAndServices.soldThrough: Subcontract to Northrop Grumman and direct DoD/NNSA vehicles
productsAndServices.roadmap: Sentinel EMD through re-baselining; silo construction waves into the 2030s

productsAndServices.name: Infrastructure, Mining & Environmental
productsAndServices.description: Global civil infrastructure (Western Sydney International Airport; delivery partner for Australia's Newcastle-Sydney High Speed Rail, awarded July 2026; Serbia's Morava Corridor motorway with ENKA), mining megaprojects (Quebrada Blanca Phase 2, Chile), and the DOE environmental-cleanup franchise — anchored by the Hanford Waste Treatment Plant, which began vitrifying tank waste in October 2025 after ~25 years of buildout (two 300-ton melters at 2,100°F; 53M gallons of waste in scope).
highlights: Hanford first glass poured October 2025 — a genuine engineering milestone shadowed by the 2016 $125M False Claims settlement and safety-culture findings
High-speed-rail delivery-partner and airport credentials keep the civil bench global
productsAndServices.positioning: The diversified megaproject base that smooths the energy/defense cycles
productsAndServices.soldThrough: Sovereign and DOE program contracts, JVs (ENKA)
productsAndServices.roadmap: Hanford DFLAW ramp toward ~5,300 gallons of tank waste per day

strategyRead: 1. (High confidence) We assess Bechtel is deliberately positioned one phase ahead of the AI construction cycle rather than inside it: it holds no reported incumbent hyperscale-GC role (the Microsoft Fairwater association did not substantiate — Walsh builds Mount Pleasant), but its NVIDIA Omniverse DSX partnership targets the moment AI campuses become gigawatt-scale energy megaprojects delivered as factory modules — the exact work profile (power, cooling, first-of-a-kind integration) where Bechtel's bench is unmatched and the commercial GCs' is thinnest.

2. (High confidence) We assess the nuclear franchise is Bechtel's most defensible AI-era asset: the only completed 21st-century US reactors (Vogtle), the first NRC-permitted utility-scale advanced reactor under construction (Natrium), and the AP1000 export seat in Poland give it execution incumbency in the power class hyperscalers are underwriting for the 2030s. No US rival can currently claim the same résumé.

3. (Moderate confidence) We assess the concurrent triple-LNG book (Rio Grande, Port Arthur, Louisiana) plus Sentinel plus Hanford concentrates enormous lump-sum and program risk in parallel: the same appetite that public rivals shed (Fluor's de-risking) is Bechtel's margin engine, but the Port Arthur fatalities, Sentinel's command-and-launch cost breach, and the Hanford legacy show each franchise carrying a live execution or reputational wound alongside its moat.

4. (Moderate confidence) We assess the safety story is now a genuine commercial variable: company-published incident rates (LTIR 0.014) collided with a triple fatality and an internal report finding systemic lapses. The October 2025 transparency (publishing the seven-factor report) was the right brand move, but LNG and nuclear clients price safety culture directly — the next award cycle will show whether the overhaul restored the premium.

5. (Moderate confidence) We assess fifth-generation family control plus $58.2B of backlog (doubled since 2020) gives Bechtel cycle-riding capacity no public EPC can match — it endured the 2018-20 revenue collapse ($21.8B → $12.2B US) that cost it a 20-year #1 rank, and rebuilt to #2 on energy/defense megaprojects without external capital. The cost is opacity: revenue definitions ($20.6B company vs $15.9B ENR for 2024) and even headcount (~30k vs ~50k) cannot be reconciled from outside.

6. (Low confidence) We assess the US-Japan AI-infrastructure framework naming (Bechtel and Kiewit, October 2025) and the ~$8.7B of 2025 LNG awards (company figure, unverified) as optionality on top of the backlog rather than bankable pipeline — treat both as directional signals until projects are assigned.
